question: Should US troops stay in Britain, yes or no?

lines.text: The Ministry of Defence says about 11,000 American troops are based in Britain.
lines.note: MoD written answer, Hansard, 15 Jan 2026: approximately 11,000 USVF members, excluding families and civilians

lines.text: Only four countries host more: Japan, Germany, South Korea and Italy.
lines.note: USAFacts / DMDC, 31 Dec 2025: UK 10,156 active duty, 5th

lines.text: The biggest is RAF Lakenheath in Suffolk, home to US F-35 and F-15 fighter jets.
lines.note: RAF Lakenheath official site: largest USAF-operated base in England, 48th Fighter Wing, F-35 and F-15

lines.text: Its fighter wing alone has more than 4,000 US military members.
lines.note: RAF Lakenheath official site: over 4,000 military members

lines.text: Just down the road, RAF Mildenhall runs the only permanent US air refuelling wing in Europe.
lines.note: RAF Mildenhall official site: 100th Air Refueling Wing, only permanent US air refueling wing in the European theater

lines.text: In Gloucestershire, RAF Fairford, where ABC News says US B-52 and B-1 bombers have flown during the Iran war.
In North Yorkshire, RAF Menwith Hill. The Intercept called it the NSA's largest overseas spying base.
lines.note: The Intercept, 6 Sep 2016, verbatim: the National Security Agency's largest overseas spying base

lines.text: It reported some 2,200 staff there, most of them American.
lines.note: The Intercept, 2016: some 2,200 personnel, the majority Americans

lines.text: Then Croughton, Welford, Alconbury, Molesworth, Feltwell, Barford St John and more.
lines.note: Sites named in the Jan 2026 parliamentary question

lines.text: So how many troops are at each one? The government won't say.
lines.note: MoD declined site-by-site numbers, Hansard 15 Jan 2026

lines.text: A defence minister told Parliament it was in the interests of personnel security.
lines.note: Alistair Carns, verbatim: In the interests of personnel security, I will not currently share specific numbers

scene.quote: In the interests of personnel security

lines.text: American forces have been based in Britain since the Second World War.
lines.note: Background: US forces in the UK since 1942

lines.text: Eleven thousand troops. More than a dozen bases. Should they stay, yes or no?
